title: Mur de feu
approval_scope: Full displayed RP, current/next damage, length/duration/range, one active wall, energy/cooldown and placement, obstacle interruption, passability, entry/standing damage cap, caster/allied damage and replacement conditions accepted as provisional balance. Unshown curves, initial tick/geometry/vision/overlap cases and native visuals remain pending.
accepted_conditions: Placement on visible passable terrain; obstacles interrupt line.
Flames remain traversable; entry or standing causes damage at most once per target per turn for this effect.
Caster and allies may be hurt; damage displayed before defenses.
One active wall for FE03; new wall replaces previous. No approval transferred to other persistent creations.
unshown_rules_approval: Full rank curves, line endpoints/orientation and diagonal/corner/range geometry, occupied cells and large actors, initial damage to actors on created tiles, first/last periodic tick and duration/reaction order, multiple-author and overlapping zones, vision and preview behavior, damage/defense and skill/implant/cost modifiers remain pending where not already accepted. No movement barrier, persistent after-exit burn status, general spell damage variance, new control, boss fire immunity or hidden actor reveal introduced.
visual_approval: existing catalogue direction only; native preview pending
